manifest_adapter_repair.aggregate_binding: Every expected dump, including EMPTY_OPTIONAL_CHANNEL, is included with record_count, logical size_bytes, physical file_size_bytes, actual sha256, and status.

empty_existing.file_size_bytes: Path.stat().st_size of the on-disk container; a header-only native TRACE may therefore be nonzero
empty_existing.sha256: SHA256 of the actual on-disk file bytes

manifest_adapter_repair.nonempty_existing: Record actual Path.stat().st_size and actual SHA256; validate any supplied native-summary byte_size and sha256.
manifest_adapter_repair.support_rule: Exclude EMPTY_OPTIONAL_CHANNEL from valid TRACE support and tracked-PRN counts; decide only after four-configuration common support is measured.
manifest_adapter_repair.tamper_rule: Any post-binding size, hash, record-count, status, threshold, model, window, handoff, receiver, or scientific-config mismatch fails closed.

audit_required_evidence: all dump files, native record counts, sizes, and SHA256
old_r4c_c0_policy.if_not_fully_recoverable: Preserve as historical incomplete evidence and run C0 in the new R4d output root.

pre_score_sequence: Commit and push this repair_preregistration.json as the only changed path.
Verify preregistration local/remote SHA equality, ahead/behind 0/0, and a clean worktree.
Implement and test only the empty-channel adapter, R4d orchestration, frozen analyzer adapter, compact verifier, and tamper checks.
Commit and push execution-repair-freeze bindings and verify local/remote SHA equality, ahead/behind 0/0, and a clean worktree.
Use a fresh clean checkout of the pushed execution-repair-freeze SHA for R4c C0 evidence audit, DS3 replay, and locked scoring.

r4c_result_preservation.supersession: R4d is a versioned engineering repair and continuation; it does not rewrite the R4c record.
